create.name: Nigel Meadows
create.bio:
Nigel Meadows is a breathwork facilitator and sound healer who works in Manchester. He came to conscious connected breathing and sound through his own search for healing, later trained and qualified in both, and has spent more than fifteen years guiding people through them. Breath is the centre of his work: a continuous, circular breathing pattern that can lead into deep relaxation, emotional release and a stronger sense of presence, supported by the sound of crystal alchemy bowls, Tibetan bowls, gongs and drums.

He offers one-to-one sessions that open with a consultation and combine breathwork with a sound journey, along with sound-only sessions and longer breathwork courses. Around Manchester he leads weekly group classes, sound baths, half-day mini retreats and seasonal gatherings that weave together movement, breath and sound, and he takes the same format to venues in Yorkshire. For people who want to guide others, he runs Breath of Life, an eight-month facilitator training with live online sessions, supervised practice and a four-day intensive in Manchester that covers technique, facilitation skills, ethics and self-inquiry.

courses.title: Breathwork and Sound Healing Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions that begin with a consultation and then pair guided conscious connected breathing with a sound journey on crystal alchemy bowls, gongs, drums and Tibetan bowls. Single sessions and packages of three or six are available, and lower-income clients are invited to ask about pricing.

courses.title: Breath of Life Breathwork Facilitator Training
courses.description: An eight-month experiential training for people who want to guide others through breathwork, including conscious connected breathing. It runs through 22 live sessions, supported one-to-one and group practice and a four-day in-person intensive in Manchester, and entry is by application.

courses.title: Resonant Presence: An Alchemy Morning Retreat
courses.description: A three-hour morning in Manchester that moves from gentle guided movement and a cup of cacao into a steady, unforced breathwork session and then a full crystal-bowl sound immersion. No experience is needed.
